# Pre-measurement simple resource-window material oracle

This is one independent complete500×301 plane for the four non-test resource factory windows. It was generated from complete original PNGs/raw metadata and original JSON, then frozen BEFORE root browser measurement. The generator imports only Node primitives and pngjs, never production renderers/helpers, product output, browser screenshots or installed consumers.

The host is500×301 logical/physical pixels at scale1, opaque external backdropRGBA[32,48,64,255]. The explicitly supplied finite Web popup intrinsic size is[250,209]; it satisfies outer50%width/min50%height/maxH−4 and places its complete window at[125,46,250,209], with integer origins. This declares a Web parent/content resolution; it does not recover native `%c`, default anchors, font metrics or full GUI rendering.

Expected source order is:

1. Full untouched control.png, uniformRGBA[9,9,9,255], drawn in[133,46,234,209] (window-local[8,0,W−16,H]), alpha1, behind the frame. Raw control.json is retained unchanged, including its degenerate-centre slice1/base2; uniform texels make a whole-source point stretch deterministic without rewriting metadata or claiming native degenerate slicing.
2. Full untouched dialog_background_hollow_3.png18×33, raw nineslice[8,23,8,8], over the complete window[125,46,250,209]. Binary source alpha0/255 either retains the backing or replaces it exactly. Independent integer/rational destination-pixel-centre pull/floor chooses each source texel; no fractional-origin or partial-alpha quantization is needed here.

The layer order is authored in progress_screen.json simple_popup_dialog_base: control layer−10. The inherited common.dialog_background_hollow_3 frame has layer2. Header centre original rows3..21 are opaque198, row22 is a divider, and the stretch-centre source rows23/24 are transparent. The fill must therefore remain behind the header, not overwrite it.

## Predeclared measurement isolation

Target selector is `#progress-resource-material-host`, a root-owned complete500×301 fixture host containing the real source window. Capture that complete target, not a cropped popup or header. The runtime can use the actual public wrapper or the private real resource core with its existing source CSS; identify which in the result. Do not synthesize a frame from expected art.

For all four simple factories, keep exact source boxes and content. Apply only `visibility:hidden` to title/description/warning glyph paint and the complete native button paint, including state skin/focus/material children. The declared plumbing selectors are `.mc-progress-resource-dialog__title .mc-progress-packs__glyph`, `.mc-progress-resource-dialog__description .mc-progress-packs__glyph`, `.mc-progress-resource-dialog__warning .mc-progress-packs__glyph` (when instantiated), and `.mc-progress-resource-dialog .mc-progress-source-button`. No `display:none`, removal, width/height/offset edits, opacity changes, masks, cropping or frame/fill isolation is allowed. Record every matching node and restore exact original style attributes after capture. Material state contains no extra browser caret/selection/focus-ring paint; focus/hover behavior is a separate qualification, and must not be silently erased to fit this expected image.

Factories `resource_pack_download_server_required`, `resource_pack_download_optional_and_required`, `resource_pack_download_optional` and `resource_pack_download_required` share this expected plane under the declared isolation and fixed height. Their real action/text/height evaluation and natural unisolated composition remain separate tests. This is not the `test` factory.

All150,500 pixels compare at tolerance0/threshold0, without ROI or per-pixel masks. Pixel/PNG identities are in EXPECTED.json, protocol in PROTOCOL.json, original provenance and hashes in SOURCE-PINS.json. Complete original resources, raw UI and license remain under ORIGINALS; generated expected art is a test fixture, never runtime material. Keep failures and complete actual planes. FROZEN.json prohibits regenerating expected references after seeing browser output.

Passing this plane proves the bounded fixed frame+fill source layering for this finite Web profile. It does not qualify native GUI, fonts, source content evaluator, native slice algorithm, other sizes/scales, buttons, natural title placement or whole popup accessibility.
